description: This file defines a mock class 'GlibWrapperMock' for the 'IGlibWrapper' interface, used for unit testing GObject/GLib related functionalities in the Rialto server project. It includes mock methods for various GLib functions and handles mock implementations for variadic functions.

classes.name: GlibWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock class for IGlibWrapper interface, providing mock implementations for GLib wrapper functions used in Rialto server tests.

methods.name: gTypeClassRef
methods.description: Mock method for gTypeClassRef, returns a gpointer given a GType.

methods.name: gTypeFromName
methods.description: Mock method for gTypeFromName, returns a GType given a class name.

methods.name: gFlagsGetValueByNick
methods.description: Mock method for gFlagsGetValueByNick, retrieves a GFlagsValue based on a nickname.

methods.name: gObjectUnref
methods.description: Mock method for gObjectUnref, unreferences a GObject.

methods.name: gSignalConnect
methods.description: Mock method for gSignalConnect, connects a signal handler.

methods.name: gSignalHandlerDisconnect
methods.description: Mock method for gSignalHandlerDisconnect, disconnects a signal handler.

methods.name: gTimeoutAdd
methods.description: Mock method for gTimeoutAdd, adds a timeout source.

methods.name: gSourceRemove
methods.description: Mock method for gSourceRemove, removes a source.

methods.name: gFree
methods.description: Mock method for gFree, frees allocated memory.

methods.name: gObjectSet
methods.description: Implementation of gObjectSet that calls gObjectSetStub for each property.

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Implementation of gObjectGet that calls gObjectGetStub for each property.
